name: Restock versus purchase contention
note: Draft reference diagnostic; not selected by scored campaigns. 80 fresh cohorts, 1000 calls per app. Half buy one unit and half restock one unit through the declared default action input. Starting stock 128 makes every purchase affordable regardless of ordering. Groups are fully prepared before release with 0/-20/-5/+5/+20ms restock offsets. Final snapshots verify net per-warehouse conservation and buyer order/payment counts; compensating errors can remain invisible. Histories record actual client dispatch; no server-overlap or throughput claim. Correct and defective reference qualification required.
